title: Outbound riff — HarborPoint account scratch
content:
Quick brain dump for HarborPoint (regional banking platform) — lightweight account research + outbound riffing. Not polished. Use as my working source for cadence experiments.

Summary thoughts:
- Target: HarborPoint (mid-market regional bank, ~120 branches, ~$1.2B deposits). Likely conservative on data residency and vendor SLAs. Primary use cases: conversational customer support, automated form intake, branch staff assistants for compliance checks.
- Why Redwood could matter: predictable latency for customer-facing flows, private deployment option (VPC/on-prem), cost controls for high-volume transactional prompts.

Key people (from LinkedIn + signal checks):
- CFO: Ellen Park — approves vendor spend over $250k, cares about unit economics and auditability.
- Head of Digital Ops: Marcus Yates — day-to-day product owner for chat/IVR trials. Loves metrics.
- Head of InfoSec: Dr. Kavita Rao — needs KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC2.
- Eng lead (platform): Josh Nguyen — will push for control plane integration with identity (Okta) and on-prem networking.

Signals / public triggers:
- Announced modernization of contact center (press release Jan 2026) -> good outreach hook.
- Job postings for "Conversations PM" and "AI Engineer" last month -> suggests active project.

Problems / Pain points to call out in outreach:
- Risk of vendor data exfiltration + long procurement cycles for cloud-based LLMs.
- Token cost spikes with naive deployments.
- Latency leading to poor contact center CX (timeouts on multi-turn).
- Need for predictable rollout (canaries, A/B tests) across branches.

Hypothesized value props (short bullets for email subject lines / intros):
- "Pilot secure, low-latency customer chat without cloud data exposure"
- "Reduce contact-center handle time by ~20% using cached prompts + batching"
- "A/B sandbox for model rollouts with rollback and audit logs"

Outbound sequence (very rough) — 6 touch attempts across channels:
1) LinkedIn connection note to Marcus Yates: quick mention of the contact center press release + 1-sentence value prop (ask for 15-min intro).
2) Short email to Marcus (subject options below) with 2-sentence TL;DR, 2 bullets (pilot scope + quick win), ask for intro to whoever owns Ops.
3) Follow-up email with one-pager (shared link) and a short case study snippet (regional bank X cut handle time 18%).
4) Call — if gatekeeper: short 2-min opener script below, ask to schedule deep dive.
5) Slack/LinkedIn nudge to Ellen Park (CFO) with high-level cost ROI line + ask for permission to send pilot costing.
6) If silence, send "We helped X bank avoid a vendor data lock-in" customer quote + offer 2-week sandbox + free pilot credits.

Subject line experiments (A/B):
- A: "A low-risk pilot to cut contact center handle time at HarborPoint"
- B: "Secure on-prem LLM pilot for contact center modernization"
- C: "Quick question about your contact center modernization"

Email body (short variant — to iterate):
Hi Marcus —
Congrats on the contact center modernization announcement. I work with Redwood Inference — we help banks run modern LLM features with private deployments and predictable per-token economics.

Two quick things we can do in a 6‑week pilot:
• Deploy a private sandbox for your agents (no customer data leaves your VPC)
• Reduce average handle time via prefix caching + routing policies

Would you be open to 15 minutes next week to scope a 6-week proof-of-value?

— Priya

Call opener / gatekeeper script (30s):
"Hi — I’m Priya from Redwood. We ran a short pilot with a regional bank that cut contact center handle time by 18% using a secure on‑prem model deployment — we can run a similar 6-week sandbox for HarborPoint with no data leaving your network. Who would be best to talk about a small technical pilot?"

Objections + quick rebuttals (cheat sheet):
- "We can’t host anything on-prem due to cost" -> "We offer a VPC-managed private deployment option and a dedicated cost model for pilot; we also provide a hosted sandbox that can be restricted to allowed IPs — we’ll size it so it’s < $X for the pilot and show unit economics."
- "We already have an LLM vendor" -> "Totally — two quick differentiators: (1) transparent token-level cost breakdowns and tooling to cut unit costs (batching, KV caching), and (2) fallback routing & model-variant rollouts so production apps don’t go down during peaks. Can we run a free migration-capacity test on a small path?"
- "Security/compliance is my main concern" -> "We provide KMS integration, per-request audit logs, and can run in your VPC or on-prem; happy to set up a technical deep dive with our security lead and provide architecture docs."

Pilot scope (MVP):
- 6-week pilot: agent-assist for IVR transcripts + chat transcripts (2 intents to start).
- Success metrics: avg handle time reduction, deflection rate, error rate on NLU intents, infra latency p50/p95.
- Deliverables: deployment diagram, rollout plan, cost estimate, 2-week sandbox access, weekly checkpoint calls.

Metrics to prepare before call (ask Marcus / ops):
- Current average handle time (global & by channel)
- Peak concurrent sessions/day
- Data retention policy (where transcripts stored)
- Current number of agents / daily chats volume

Notes to self — signals to verify before demo:
- Can they open a VPN peering/Direct Connect? (important for pilot)
- Primary compliance framework: GLBA? PCI? State-level regs?
- Who signs SOWs for vendors under $250k (Ellen?)

Play/test ideas (experiments):
- Run two subject lines for first outreach; track opens + reply rate; keep for 4 weeks.
- Offer a "no-data-leaves-network" video demo (short gif) showing latency and streaming UI — more convincing than words.
- Prepare a 1-page costing sheet comparing hosted vs dedicated vs private over 12 months for their estimated volume.

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Verify exact branch count (public reports say 120, DB may show 115) — ask sales intel.
- [ ] Get customer quote from past bank pilot (anonymized) for one-pager — ping Marco.
- [ ] Build 2-min GIF demo of streaming with 150ms p50 on small GPU config — ask infra for perf run.
- [ ] Draft SOW template for 6-week sandbox (legal review needed).

Edge-case scripts (if they bring up "we have internal LLM team"):
- Offer to run a 1-day joint workshop with their team to identify ops gaps (batching, KV caching, rollouts) — positioning as low-commit discovery.

Last-minute quick resources to attach to outreach (links to include):
- 1-pager: "How Redwood keeps bank PII inside your VPC"
- Case study: "Midwest Regional Bank — pilot results"
- Security brief: "KMS & audit logs for private deployments"

Final note: keep outreach conversational and explicitly namedrop the press release and person (Marcus job posting). Avoid heavy product spec in first two touches; focus on risk reduction + measurable win (handle time).

End of riff. Will iterate after first two replies.

-- Priya (working doc)

PS: try subject A on Marcus, subject B on Ellen (different framing: Marcus=ops impact, Ellen=cost/ROI).
